description: MainActivity class for Android app implementing bottom navigation, theme toggle, and fragment management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point activity managing main UI with bottom navigation, theme toggle, and fragment transitions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets theme, content view, toolbar, bottom navigation, and loads default fragment.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and updates the theme toggle icon and description based on current theme.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling dark/light mode and recreating activity.

methods.name: openFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment in the container with the provided fragment instance.
